reference: Dummy measurement how-to guide copy for user validation; illustrations are schematic placeholders.
notes: Keep tape level and relaxed unless a field says otherwise.
Repeat tape measurements two or three times and log the median when precision matters.
Replace illustration keys with reviewed artwork before public SEO launch.

guides.label: Height
guides.summary: Standing height without shoes, measured against a wall or stadiometer.
steps: Stand barefoot with heels, upper back, and head near a flat wall.
Look straight ahead and keep the measuring edge level.
Record the value in centimeters after a normal inhale.

guides.label: Weight
guides.summary: Scale weight under repeatable conditions.
steps: Use the same scale on a hard surface.
Weigh after waking and bathroom use when possible.
Treat single-day changes as noise; use the trend.
commonMistakes: reacting to sodium or meal weight

guides.label: Head circumference
guides.summary: Tape around the largest head circumference.
steps: Place the tape above the eyebrows and around the widest back of the skull.
Keep the tape snug without compressing hair or skin.
Measure twice and use the repeatable value.
commonMistakes: tape too low at the forehead

guides.label: Neck circumference
guides.summary: Tape around the lower neck without compressing tissue.
steps: Stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Wrap tape around the lower neck near the Adam's apple level.
Keep the tape level and record a relaxed value.

guides.label: Biacromial width
guides.summary: Straight-line shoulder bone width from acromion to acromion.
steps: Find the bony point at the top outside of each shoulder.
Use a rigid ruler or calipers if available.
Measure straight across, not around the back.

guides.label: Bideltoid width
guides.summary: Straight-line maximum width across the deltoids.
steps: Stand relaxed with arms hanging naturally.
Measure the widest left-to-right shoulder span across the delts.
Use a mirror or helper to keep the measuring line horizontal.

guides.label: Bideltoid circumference
guides.summary: Tape around the shoulders at the widest deltoid line.
steps: Wrap tape around the shoulders and upper chest at the deltoid peak.
Keep arms down and relaxed.
Keep tape level around the back.

guides.label: Armpit circumference
guides.summary: Upper chest circumference near the armpit line.
steps: Wrap tape high around the chest, close to the armpits.
Stand relaxed with arms down.
Record after a normal exhale.

guides.label: Nipple circumference
guides.summary: Chest circumference across the nipple line.
steps: Wrap tape across the nipple line and around the back.
Keep the tape level and parallel to the floor.
Record a relaxed exhale value.
commonMistakes: tape sloping upward on the back

guides.label: Underbust
guides.summary: Circumference directly under the chest.
steps: Place tape directly under the chest or pec line.
Keep it snug but not compressive.
Measure after a relaxed exhale.
commonMistakes: letting tape sit on soft chest tissue

guides.label: Waist
guides.summary: Narrowest relaxed torso circumference.
steps: Find the narrowest relaxed point between ribs and hips.
Keep tape level and do not suck in.
Measure after a normal exhale.

guides.label: Pant waist
guides.summary: Circumference where pants normally sit.
steps: Place tape at the natural pants waistband position.
Keep posture relaxed and tape level.
Record separately from narrowest waist.

guides.label: Hip / buttock circumference
guides.summary: Largest circumference around hips and buttocks.
steps: Stand with feet close and weight even.
Wrap tape around the largest hip and buttock point.
Check in a mirror that the tape is level.

guides.label: Upper thigh circumference
guides.summary: Upper thigh circumference near the glute fold.
steps: Stand relaxed with weight evenly distributed.
Measure the upper thigh near the glute fold.
Use the same side and same distance from the hip each time.

guides.label: Mid-thigh circumference
guides.summary: Thigh circumference halfway between hip and knee.
steps: Mark halfway between hip crease and top of kneecap.
Wrap tape perpendicular to the leg.
Record relaxed, not flexed.

guides.label: Calf circumference
guides.summary: Largest calf circumference.
steps: Stand with weight evenly distributed.
Find the largest point of the calf.
Measure the same leg each time unless tracking left/right later.

guides.label: Bicep circumference
guides.summary: Upper-arm circumference at the largest point.
steps: Let the arm hang relaxed unless deliberately tracking flexed size.
Measure around the largest upper-arm point.
Use the same arm and state each time.

guides.label: Upper forearm circumference
guides.summary: Forearm circumference near the largest upper forearm point.
steps: Relax hand and forearm.
Measure around the largest forearm point below the elbow.
Keep the tape perpendicular to the forearm.

guides.label: Wrist circumference
guides.summary: Wrist circumference at the narrowest point.
steps: Wrap tape around the narrowest wrist point.
Keep hand relaxed and tape snug.
Record as a frame reference, not a weekly change target.

guides.label: Ankle circumference
guides.summary: Ankle circumference at the narrowest point above the ankle bones.
steps: Stand or sit with the foot relaxed and flat.
Wrap tape around the narrowest point just above the ankle bones.
Keep the tape snug without pressing into skin.
commonMistakes: placing tape too high on the calf
